cause: Several player or preview coroutines yielded the same cached ResourceRequest, which Unity rejects.
fix: Keep a single shared resource request and let each coroutine wait for isDone by yielding frames.

baseline.error: This asynchronous operation is already being yielded from another coroutine. An asynchronous operation can only be yielded once.

regressionCases: Two actual Unity coroutines share an in-flight request and both receive the same visual.
Stopping one waiter does not stop another waiter or a replacement waiter.
Loaded visuals are reused without issuing a new resource request.
